It begins with entering all financial transactions into a ledger, which may be recorded in a book or computer system that tracks the financial activity of a business.

steps.heading: Recording of transactions
steps.desc: Bookkeeping is an important part of the accounting process and is essential for any business, regardless of its size or industry. All financial transactions are recorded in the books of accounts in chronological order.

steps.heading: Classification of transactions
steps.desc: The recorded transactions are classified into different accounts, such as assets, liabilities, equity, income, and expenses.

steps.heading: Summarizing of transactions

value.title: The double-entry system
value: This is the most common system of bookkeeping in India. It requires that every financial transaction be recorded twice, once as a debit and once as a credit. This helps to ensure that the books of accounts are balanced.

title: Income Tax Filing
h1: Best Tax Preparation Services in Chennai
description: Income tax filing is a key part of India's economic development. It is a way for the government to collect revenue to fund essential services, such as education, healthcare, and infrastructure.

value: Income Tax Return (ITR) filing in India is the process of submitting an annual tax return to the Income Tax Department of India. It is a requirement for individuals and businesses with taxable income above a certain threshold. The ITR filing process is designed to collect taxes from taxpayers and to ensure that everyone pays their fair share

To file an ITR, taxpayers must provide information about their income, deductions, and tax credits. This information can be gathered from various sources, such as Form 16 (for salaried employees), Form 26AS (for taxpayers who have made TDS payments), and bank statements.

ITR 2- For Individuals and HUFs not having income from profits and gains of business or profession
ITR 3- For individuals and HUFs having income from profits and gains of business or profession.
ITR 4 - Presumptive Income scheme for individuals HUF and Firms
ITR 5 - Firm, LLP, AOP and BOI

description: TDS Return Filing is compulsory needed quarterly by all entities and persons who have deducted tax at Source. Aanoor Global can help to prepare and file TDS return easily at an affordable rate. TDS is an important part of the Indian tax system. template.value: TDS returns filing is the process of submitting a quarterly statement to the Income Tax Department (ITD) detailing the amount of tax deducted at source (TDS) by a deductor from the payments made to a deductee during a specified quarter. The TDS returns are filed using Form 24Q for salaries, Form 26Q for non-salary payments, and Form 27Q for additional income like interest, dividends, or any other amount payable to NRIs (foreigners).

template.header: ROC filing for Pvt Ltd Company
template.value: ROC filing refers to the submission of various documents and returns to the Registrar of Companies (ROC). The ROC is a government body that is responsible for registering and regulating companies in India. Filing of ROC compliance is a mandatory requirement for all companies registered in India. ROC filings can also be used by investors and other stakeholders to assess the financial health and governance of companies.

template.header: There are some of the common ROC filings that companies are required to do

value.title: Annual return
value: This is a document that provides information about the company's financial performance, board of directors, and shareholders. It must be filed within 60 days of the conclusion of the company's annual general meeting (AGM).

value.title: Audited financial statements
value: These are the financial statements of the company that have been audited by a qualified auditor. They must be filed within 30 days of the conclusion of the AGM.

value.title: Change in company information
value: This filing is required to be made whenever there is a change in the company's information, such as its name, address, directors, or shareholders.

value.title: Other filings
value: There are several other ROC filings that companies may be required to make, depending on their specific circumstances.

template.header: The key forms that need to be filed as part of the annual compliance are
value: Form MGT-7: Annual return
Form AOC-4: Financial statements
Form DIR-3: Directors' report
Form MGT-14: Minutes of the annual general meeting
Form ADT-1: Appointment of auditor
Form ADT-2: Resignation of auditor
Form ADT-3: Change in auditor's address

template.header: Benefits to ROC annual compliance for companies

value.title: Maintaining a company's active status
value: If a company fails to comply with ROC annual compliance requirements, its status with the ROC may be changed to "dormant" or "struck off." This can make it difficult or impossible for the company to carry out certain activities, such as opening a bank account or filing taxes.

value.title: Avoiding penalties
value: The ROC can impose penalties on companies that fail to comply with annual compliance requirements. These penalties can be significant, and they can also damage a company's reputation.

value.title: Protecting investors
value: ROC annual compliance requirements help to protect investors by ensuring that companies are transparent about their financial performance and governance practices. This information can help investors to make informed investment decisions.

value.title: Enhancing a company's credibility
value: ROC annual compliance demonstrates that a company is taking its legal obligations seriously. This can help to build trust with customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

value.title: Ensuring compliance with other laws
value: ROC annual compliance requirements often overlap with requirements under other laws, such as tax laws and labor laws. By complying with ROC annual compliance requirements, companies can help to ensure that they are also complying with other applicable laws.
